notes:
- Part files are now `.cable` files. Older `.cable.json` files still open; when you save one, the app offers to convert it to `.cable` in place, keeping its runs folder.
- Double-click a `.cable` file to open it in Cable Design Center. You can also drag one onto the window.
- Custom materials, dielectric presets, and shapes now travel with the file. If a file uses entries you don't have, a notice offers **Add to my library**; until then they apply to that design only.
